name: infranodus-skills
description: InfraNodus skills for Claude: text network analysis, knowledge graphs, content gap detection, SEO, and cognitive variability workflows.

plugins.name: infranodus-all
plugins.description: The complete InfraNodus skills collection: all 15 skills in one install — text network analysis, knowledge graphs, SEO, planning, writing, and cognitive variability workflows.

plugins.name: infranodus
plugins.description: Text network analysis and knowledge graphs via the InfraNodus MCP server: content gaps, research questions, SEO/GEO optimization, GraphRAG retrieval, repo and vault graphs.

plugins.name: actionize
plugins.description: Turn insights or research into an actionable plan with deadlines and scheduled Telegram reminders.

plugins.name: cognitive-variability
plugins.description: Guide conversations through shifts between zoom levels and connecting/exploring modes to unlock creative breakthroughs and prevent rigid thinking.

plugins.name: critical-perspective
plugins.description: Critical thinking: question assumptions, explore alternative perspectives, and uncover latent topics in conversations.

plugins.name: embodied-navigation
plugins.description: Transfer embodied movement principles (meditation, martial arts, dance) to navigate complex situations mapped as knowledge graphs.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Set up and maintain a personal LLM-authored wiki: an interlinked, compounding knowledge base built from raw sources with knowledge graph support.

plugins.name: ontology-generator
plugins.description: Generate ontological knowledge graphs in [[wikilinks]] syntax for Obsidian / InfraNodus visualization and gap analysis.

plugins.name: perspective-reversal
plugins.description: Flip any conflict or negotiation to the opponent's perspective to extract superior tactical advice and counter-moves.

plugins.name: rhetorical-analyst
plugins.description: Analyze arguments, debate tactics, and rhetorical moves across persuasion, rhetoric, and logic dimensions.

plugins.name: seo-analysis
plugins.description: SEO analysis: keyword research, content gap analysis, search intent, and optimization recommendations using real Google data.

plugins.name: shifting-perspective
plugins.description: Diagnose the structural diversity of a text with knowledge graph analysis and actively shift its perspective.

plugins.name: shopping-assistant
plugins.description: Systematic shopping research: comparison matrices, review analysis, and value assessment converging on the best options.

plugins.name: vipassana-llm
plugins.description: Apply Vipassana meditation principles to LLM processing: equanimous scanning, non-reactive observation, impermanence awareness.

plugins.name: youtube-viral-optimizer
plugins.description: Generate high-CTR YouTube thumbnails, titles, and video scripts optimized for virality and algorithm positioning.

plugins.name: writing-assistant
plugins.description: Refine texts in any language: grammar, style, paraphrasing, and grammatical pattern detection that signals cognitive states.
